blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead prosecutor Gerville Luistro said Friday that the defense’s sluggish presentation of witnesses and requests to defer trial dates validate the prosecution’s earlier decision to withdraw three of four Articles of Impeachment and proceed only with Article II, the allegation that Vice President Sara Duterte amassed unexplained wealth and failed to declare it in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth. Luistro said the prosecution had manifested before open court on October 13 that it would no longer pursue those three articles, and argued that more time would have been consumed had that move not been made.
